name: vortex
title: Vortex
blurb: Spinning spiral of colors draws focus to the center.
description: Animated gradient vortex using CSS transforms and keyframe rotation; responsive to viewport.
use_when: Attention-grabbing hero sections or loading states needing visual motion.
avoid_when: Layouts with vestibular motion sensitivity concerns; may cause discomfort.
a11y: Decorative background. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
